title: HERDPhobia: A Dataset for Hate Speech against Fulani in Nigeria

bias_targets.methodology: Creating an annotated dataset (HERDPhobia) of tweets targeting the Fulani ethnic group in three languages (English, Nigerian-Pidgin, and Hausa) and evaluating the performance of pre-trained language models (XLM-T, mBERT, AfriBERTa) on classifying the text as hateful or non-hateful.
